outlook.statement: The Board of Directors of your Company is optimistic about the future prospects of the Company. Your directors are of the view that the Company will have a progressive growth in the subsequent financial years and are hopeful for the bright future prospects.

Sahara Maritime Limited remains optimistic about the long-term prospects of the maritime industry. The Company is strategically placed to capitalize on industry growth trends and emerging opportunities. Strategic focus on service excellence, technological advancement, and market expansion will continue to drive growth and strengthen market position.

risks: The Company has established a well-defined process of risk management, wherein the identification, analysis and assessment of the various risks, measuring of the probable impact of such risks, formulation of risk mitigation strategy and implementation of the same takes place in a structured manner. Though the various risks associated with the business cannot be eliminated completely, all efforts are made to minimize the impact of such risks on the operations of the Company.
Infrastructure Limitations: Persistent issues with inadequate infrastructure and port congestion may impact operational efficiency and extend turnaround times
Manpower Availability: Ensuring skilled manpower and managing crew rotations remain key operational concerns
Regulatory Uncertainty: Dynamic trade and maritime regulations require continuous monitoring and compliance
Maintenance Costs: Regular inspection, survey, and compliance requirements lead to increased costs and possible operational delays
Security Risks: Cyber threats, piracy, and geopolitical instability continue to impact the maritime ecosystem
Global Volatility: Ongoing geopolitical conflicts and trade sanctions may cause disruption in global trade routes and cost escalations
Market Risk: Fluctuations in freight rates, demand-supply dynamics, and changes in trade policies
Operational Risk: Fleet maintenance, safety protocols, technology investment needs
Regulatory Risk: Compliance with global maritime regulations, environmental, safety, and governance standards
Inherent limitations of internal financial controls over financial reporting, including possibility of collusion or improper management override of controls
Projections of evaluation of internal financial controls to future periods subject to risk that controls may become inadequate due to changes in conditions or deterioration in compliance
